purpose: Required rejection cases of §10.2, one document per case. Each is llama3-8b (or, for template cases, shieldstral-3b-composite) with one mutation; the runner expects the named code and message.

cases.note: An unknown top-level field is refused by the grammar, not ignored (I2).
Unresolved contract reference.
A version the catalog does not hold.
An argument the contract does not declare is refused (§8.1).
A required argument without a declared default.
A required field of a record argument.
A YaRN record without the factor its computation uses: the paper's 0.1·ln(factor)+1 and Ministral 3's 1 are two published readings, so the document states it (finding 10).
An enum value outside its declared set (§6 V3).
A cardinality given as text.
A cardinality below zero.

cases.match: 'head_dim' = True is a boolean, not cardinality
cases.note: A boolean where an integer is declared: not coerced.
A real given as text, inside a record.
A boolean given as text.
A scalar where a record is declared.
A misspelled record field is unknown, not ignored: the mutation test of §10.2.
An enum two records deep.
A field whose present_when is false is forbidden, not ignored (I2).
A template argument outside the interval its external quantity declares (§4.6 admissibility).
A template argument outside the set its external quantity declares: the enum type refuses it before the domain does.
An external quantity without default, left unassigned at the call site.
There is no context namespace: a document references only its own quantities, indices and arguments (V1).
Liveness is derived, never declared (§4.4).
mask: chunked requires its span.
A chunk span with a mask that is not chunked is forbidden, not ignored (I2, V8).
A sliding window on a chunked mask is a meaningless combination (V8).
A site guard over an index that does not exist cannot be decided: refused, never false (I7).
A binding guard over an undeclared quantity.
A binding `when` that excludes one index leaves that port unfed: the guard is read, not ignored (mutation test, §10.2).

cases.match: binding 'decoder.attn.norm_in' is declared both in composition 'decoder' and at the top level
cases.note: A scoped rule whose expanded name collides with a top-level rule has two readings (V12).
A scoped endpoint naming no site of its composition.

cases.match: quantity 'head_dim' = 96 disagrees with its derivation, which gives 128
cases.note: A configuration value that contradicts the structure it is derived from (I8).
Two derivations that read each other never resolve: a cycle is refused, never guessed.
A derivation over a quantity the document does not declare.
A derived cardinality that is not an integer: the rounding must be chosen explicitly (floor or ceiling division).
A parser keeping the last value would drop a declaration silently; the JSON layer refuses duplicates (V12).
Every output port of an emitted occurrence is consumed or exposed (V13).
Totality covers state slots (V7).
Uniqueness: an input port has one producer (V7).
Uniqueness: a slot has one binding (V7).
A dtype selected on a parameter identity is admissible for every member's role (V14).

cases.match: is exclusive, it cannot be tied
cases.note: Tied members are shareable, roles listed in each other's rules, shapes equal (V15).

cases.match: carried across fragments, but its stream
cases.note: A carried state sits on a fragmented stream (V16).
A public input is an edge like any other: its kind must be the port's (V5).
A stream an input joins must be introduced by another input (V1).
Dtypes are selected on identities, never on occurrences.
Carrying across fragments is derived, never declared.
A public input lists its destinations and declares a kind; the domain object is gone.
One tensor left unlocated in a document that locates the others: locations are total or absent (V17).
Two untied identities naming one physical tensor: a physical tensor is bound once (I9, V17).
Two slices of one physical tensor overlapping (V17).
A stack over a name that is not an axis of the slot's shape (V17).
A slice as a part of a concat: its extent along the axis would be unknown (V17).
A document that locates its weights and instantiates a template: a template instance's tensors have no location, a stated limit (V17).
A public input is an edge like any other (§5.3): the ports it feeds must compose (V4). Here `tokens` feeds a token-index port and a width-vector port.

cases.match: conv_frontend@conv_frontend reads across positions of the fragmented stream 'audio'
cases.note: Voxtral Realtime's front end without `streaming`: a causal convolution reads neighbouring frames of a fragmented stream and carries nothing across its fragments, so the fragments would not compute what the whole stream does (V18). The corpus document declares `streaming: true` and the two history rings.
